plan.notes: Source: official SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, University Studies Programs section (catalog pp. 261-270; PDF text lines ~18024-18135), 'BUS/MAT University Studies Education 4+1 Program - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog'. This is a DISTINCT plan, not the base BUS plan: different general-education option lists (Mathematics choice, Biology Science choice/Lab, Physical Science choice/Lab) and 12 graduate MAT hours embedded in semesters 7-8, plus a Summer term and semesters 9-10 of graduate study. Sequence numbered n=1..11: n=1-8 = Fall/Spring Semesters 1-8, n=9 = Summer (after Semester 8), n=10 = Fall Semester 9, n=11 = Spring Semester 10 (catalog semester numbers 9-10 preserved in the labels). Semesters 1-8 sum to 120, which per the catalog text = 108 undergraduate + 12 graduate hours (the 12 MAT hours in semesters 7-8 count toward the undergraduate degree); total 138 = 108 undergraduate + 30 graduate, matching the printed 'Total hours required for major - 138 hours (108 undergraduate + 30 hours graduate)'. Concentration placeholders coded CONC1/CONC2/CONC3, choice=true (Primary 30 hours incl. 15 upper-level; 2nd 12; 3rd 12). World/Global Studies choice coded WGS (University Studies Core). Elective placeholders coded ELECTIVE, choice=true. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed option's code. Credit ranges: none present. Category mapping: core = general-education courses/choices; major = university requirement (GSTD 1002), University Studies Core courses (SPCH 1113, USTD 3003, WGS choice), concentration-area courses, and all MAT graduate courses; elective = elective slots. DISCREPANCY (kept verbatim): the Summer plan prints 'MAT 5003 Survey of Exceptional Individuals' while the MAT Requirements list names 'MAT 5023 - Survey of Exceptional Individuals'; kept as printed in each location. No per-course prerequisites are stated in the plan table; external_prereqs is empty.
